title: 第23章  龙象般若功诞生第24章  龙牙
slug: 从龙象般若功开始创武成圣
content_zh:
【消耗十二缕兽象气，龙象般若功已补全圆满。】
【龙象般若功—一阶极品武学。】
【简介：此功一分十三重，前三重务实根基，威能不显，之后每提升一重，都涌升数百斤力。
修至十重，实力翻天覆地，可有一龙一象之力，修至十三重巅峰，当有十龙十象之力！】
【创武进度—100%】
【修行进度—30%】
·······
创武圆满的那一刻。
随武道印记的提示音一起响起的，还有武道圣胎给予的武道反馈。
蒙蒙功德白光再次把他包裹。
这一次白光更甚之前，也更加温暖舒适。
他能感觉到，这白光在洗涤他肉身，壮养他元神。
根骨资质，悟性天赋，都因这白光有所提升。
除此之外，身体内部还有一股股白色气旋生成。
它们在四肢百骸间游动，滋润五脏六腑，充实筋骨皮膜。
而后一分为三。
一入上丹田泥丸宫，守神镇心。
二入中丹田绛宫，孕养肉身。
最后一股落入脐下小腹下丹田处，蓄养元气，增寿延命。
而这就是内力了！

【开创出极品武学，获得一次洗练肉身的机会，已反馈完毕。】
【开创出极品武学，获得十年内力，已反馈完毕。】
“十年内力，开创出一门武学，就直接给了相当于E级武者修行十年的内力！”
近乎易筋洗髓的变化，让苏青喜不自胜。
这次创武反馈，比之铁牛修行铁布衫的反馈要大的多。
但他身体却没有半点不适。
好像这些内力与生俱来，就是他自己辛苦练来的一样。
“的确是我辛苦得来的。
这龙象般若功，作为我尝试开创的第一门武学，大纲草稿，可是在我没上小学时就弄出来了。
之后经过十年不断改进，得到观看武仙真迹的机缘造化，消耗了一次武道圣胎的修行机会，以及冒险得来的兽象气。
才终于开创成功。
我的努力，配的上这份收获！”
content_en:
[After consuming twelve rays of beast-elephant energy, the Dragon-Elephant Prajna Gong has been completed. 】
[Dragon-Elephant Prajna Kung Fu—First-level martial arts. 】
[Introduction: This skill is divided into thirteen levels. The first three levels are pragmatic and have little power. Each subsequent level increases the power by hundreds of kilograms.
After cultivating to the tenth level, one's strength will be earth-shaking, and one can have the power of one dragon and one elephant. After cultivating to the peak of the thirteenth level, one should have the power of ten dragons and ten elephants! 】
[Creation of martial arts progress—100%]
[Practice progress—30%]
·······
The moment when Chuangwu is completed.
Along with the sound of the martial arts mark, there was also the martial arts feedback given by the martial arts saint.
The white light of misty merit enveloped him again.
This time the white light was even brighter than before, and it was also warmer and more comfortable.
He could feel the white light washing his body and nourishing his spirit.
His abilities, understanding and talent have all been improved due to this white light.
In addition, there are white cyclones generated inside the body.
They swim among the limbs and bones, nourishing the internal organs and enriching the skin and membranes of muscles and bones.
Then it was divided into three.
Once you enter the Upper Dantian Niwan Palace, you will guard your mind and calm your mind.
Second, enter the Jiang Palace in the middle Dantian to conceive and nourish the physical body.
The last one falls into the Dantian area under the lower abdomen under the navel to build up vitality and prolong life.
And this is internal strength!
[Create the best martial arts and get an opportunity to refine your physical body. Feedback has been completed. 】
[Created the best martial arts, gained ten years of inner strength, and the feedback has been completed. 】
"Ten years of internal strength, creating a martial arts, directly gives the internal strength equivalent to ten years of training for an E-level warrior!"
Su Qing was overjoyed at the change that was almost like a muscle-changing and marrow-cleansing one.
The feedback from Chuangwu this time was much greater than the feedback from Tieniu Cultivation Tiebushan.
But he didn't feel any physical discomfort at all.
It's as if these inner powers are innate and are the result of his hard work.
“It’s indeed something I earned through hard work.
Dragon Elephant Prajna Kung Fu was the first martial art I tried to create. The draft outline was completed when I was not in elementary school.
After ten years of continuous improvement, I got the opportunity to see the real work of Wu Xian, which consumed a chance to practice martial arts and the beast-like energy gained from adventure.
Only then did it finally succeed.
My efforts are worthy of this harvest! "
